name: yaml
resume: CRAN yaml 2.3.12 is inventoried. All 6 exports are checked. PyYAML parses the events. yes, no, 1:20, and as.yaml's layout follow the R package. There is no crate.

functions.name: as.yaml
functions.done: Writes yes and no, quotes strings whose implicit tag is not a string, and keeps each atomic vector as a sequence.

check.case: foo is 1 through 10 and bar is test1, test2

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(yaml))
one <- function() {
  txt <- as.yaml(list(foo = 1:10, bar = c("test1", "test2")))
  gsub("\n", "|", sub("\n$", "", txt))
}
ans <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(ans, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from r_yaml import as_yaml
from r_yaml.types import Vector

value = {
    "foo": Vector(list(range(1, 11)), "integer"),
    "bar": Vector(["test1", "test2"], "character"),
}

def one():
    return as_yaml(value).rstrip("\n").replace("\n", "|")

ans = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(ans)
print(f"{statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

functions.name: read_yaml
functions.done: Reads a path or the text argument, joins the lines, and parses them with yaml_load.

check.case: a file with flag y and octal 015

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(yaml))
path <- tempfile()
writeLines(c("flag: y", "oct: 015"), path)
one <- function() {
  value <- read_yaml(path)
  paste(value$flag, value$oct, sep = ",")
}
ans <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(ans, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

from r_yaml import read_yaml

path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".yml")
Path(path).write_text("flag: y\noct: 015\n", encoding="utf-8")

def one():
    value = read_yaml(path)
    flag = "TRUE" if value["flag"] else "FALSE"
    return f"{flag},{value['oct']}"

ans = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(ans)
print(f"{statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")

functions.name: verbatim_logical
functions.done: Turns TRUE and FALSE into the unquoted words true and false.

check.case: TRUE and FALSE passed through the logical handler

proof.r:

functions.name: yaml.load_file
functions.done: Reads a path or a stream as lines and passes them to yaml_load.
